title: The barber
decides: Same place and people, an important new event, inside 15 s: one call or a cut at the event?
setting: A small neighbourhood barber shop on a quiet afternoon: one black leather chair in front of a wide mirror with round bulbs, a worn wooden counter, warm tungsten light inside and soft daylight from the front window.

subjects.words: Marcus, the barber, mid-forties, shaved head, grey beard, black apron over a white t-shirt
Dev, the customer, early twenties, short dark hair in a fresh fade, a black cape over his shoulders

beats.text: Dev sits in the chair. Marcus dusts Dev's neck with a talc brush, then takes hold of the cape at Dev's shoulders.
Marcus pulls the cape off with a flick. Dev stands up, runs a hand over the fade in the mirror and grins. They shake hands.

checks: Neck dusted, then cape off, then Dev stands, then the handshake, in order
Dev stands up (he does not stay in the chair)
Same two men and the same shop from start to end
No visible jump at the cut
